pipeline.modality: Topical ophthalmic small-molecule fixed-dose combination eye drop
pipeline.target: LFA-1 / ICAM-1 (lifitegrast) plus tear-film evaporation suppressant (perfluorohexyloctane)
pipeline.license_origin: Internal (combination of two BLCO-marketed assets: XIIDRA acquired from Novartis 2023; MIEBO acquired via Novaliq partnership)

indications.trial_name: A Study Evaluating the Safety and Efficacy of a Fixed-Dose Combination for Dry Eye Disease
indications.trial_design: Randomized, vehicle-controlled, dose-ranging Phase 2 study comparing the FDC vs. each monotherapy and vehicle
key_milestones: First fixed-dose combination targeting both evaporative and inflammatory dry-eye mechanisms (per FY2025 10-K Pharmaceuticals pipeline narrative)

aka: First-in-class neurosensory agent for ocular surface pain
pipeline.modality: Topical ophthalmic small-molecule (neurosensory agent, ophthalmic solution)
pipeline.target: Ocular surface neurosensory pain pathway (specific target undisclosed)

indications.indication: Postoperative ocular pain (post-photorefractive keratectomy) / ocular surface pain
indications.trial_name: A Study to Evaluate the Use of Topical Ocular BL1332 for the Management of Postoperative Ocular Pain Following Photorefractive Keratectomy (and supporting P1 SAD/MAD)
indications.trial_design: Phase 2 dose-ranging (low-dose vs high-dose vs vehicle) in post-PRK patients; supported by completed/active Phase 1 ascending-concentration study in healthy volunteers
indications.trial_status: P2 NOT_YET_RECRUITING (start 2026-04, primary completion 2027-02); P1 ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING (primary completion 2026-11)
key_milestones: Phase 1 completed; Phase 2 readout anticipated H2 2026 per FY2025 10-K

pipeline.target: Dual mechanism — IOP reduction plus visual-function neuroprotection (specific target undisclosed)

indications.trial_name: Phase 2 Study of BL1107 Eye Drops vs. Timolol in Adults With Primary Open Angle Glaucoma or Ocular Hypertension
indications.trial_design: Randomized active-controlled Phase 2 — BL1107 low dose and high dose vs. Timolol maleate 0.5% (active comparator)
key_milestones: Positioned as 'first glaucoma therapy to lower IOP and improve visual function' per FY2025 10-K; Phase 2 results expected H2 2026

commercial_product.note: BLCO is a global eye-health company across three segments: Vision Care (contact lenses incl. Biotrue ONEday, Bausch + Lomb ULTRA, INFUSE; lens-care products; OTC eye vitamins), Pharmaceuticals (XIIDRA / lifitegrast for dry eye, MIEBO / perfluorohexyloctane for evaporative DED, VYZULTA, LUMIFY, BESIVANCE, PROLENSA, generic ophthalmics), and Surgical (enVista IOL platform incl. enVista Aspire/Envy/Beyond, LuxLife trifocal IOLs, Stellaris Elite phaco, Vitesse vitrectomy, ELIOS minimally-invasive glaucoma surgery — U.S. submission anticipated H1 2026). Surgical/lens products follow 510(k)/PMA device pathways.
